newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland to end Celuloza talks next week.
newsitem.headline: Poland to end Celuloza talks next week.

text.p: The treasury ministry is likely to conclude talks on selling a 65 percent stake of Poland's largest paper maker, Celuloza SA, to South Africa's Mondi next week, the deputy treasury minister said on Friday.
"We will finalise it (the talks) next week," Andrzej Smietanko told a news conference.

Earlier the ministry said that a consortium led by Mondi, a unit of Anglo-American Corp of South Africa and its Austrian subsidiary Frantschach AG had won the right to be the sole bidder in the Celuloza privatisation tender.
In April the treasury ministry sold 15 percent or 7.5 million shares of Celuloza in a public subscription at 20.5 zlotys per share. Celuloza closed on Friday at 16.9 zlotys.
